description.value:
Automatic

You stop being someone who found the band. Once per day, declare a Standing Broadcast: for 24 hours, every ally anywhere on the same continent may reroll one failed check per hour, spending nothing, whether or not they can hear anything at all.

Nobody has ever found the transmitter, and after this the question changes shape — because there is now definitely at least one, and it is walking around, and people can hear it in rooms it has never been in.
